decisions: REST Broadcast only (R1). No wal2json, logical decoding, publications, replication slots, database triggers, or postgres_changes on any Yellowmind database.

agentstore.role: authoritative relational store: semantic_model definitions, semantic_jobs, runtime schemas, semantic_api curated reads
agentstore.age: not installed and not required here

realtime_control.role: Supabase Realtime internal state only (tenants, extensions, realtime schema). Never business data.
realtime_control.note: Supabase-flavored image required: tenant migrations expect supabase_admin/authenticated roles and the realtime schema.

postgrest.data_role: semantic_api_user (SELECT on curated view + underlying models, RLS-bound)

realtime.tenant: yellowmind-semantic (broadcast-only; extension record points at the control DB, never agentstore)
realtime.channel_authorization: private channels + RLS policy on realtime.messages scoped to topic LIKE 'semantic-model:%'; per-model scoping enforced at token issuance until claim-based policy lands with the NestJS bridge

env_layout: per-service files beside the compose file (postgrest.env, realtime.env; both gitignored, templates committed as *.example.env). PostgREST receives only PGRST_* values; --env-file realtime.env supplies compose interpolation. Never share one file across services.

scripts.sql/001_curated_api.sql: semantic_api, definer helper, RLS, security-invoker view (applied as semantic_app)
scripts.sql/002_source_authorization.sql: grant-bound source RLS replacing membership-only source access (applied as semantic_app)
scripts.provision_tenant.py: idempotent tenant + namespace policy (control DB only)
scripts.verify_dataplane.py: anon denial, RLS read, private broadcast round-trip

run.bootstrap: BOOT_SU_AGENTSTORE=<transient-superuser-url> BOOT_SU_AGEGRAPH=<transient-superuser-url> SEM_APP_PW=<generated> SEM_AUTH_PW=<generated> SEM_AGE_PW=<generated> DEFINITIONS_SQL=YellowStorm/back/scripts/semantic-model/000_deploy_all.sql RUNTIME_MIGRATION=YellowStorm/semantic-model-runtime/migrations/001_durable_jobs.sql CURATED_SQL=YellowStorm/semantic-model-runtime/deploy/data-plane/sql/001_curated_api.sql conda run -n meta python YellowStorm/semantic-model-runtime/deploy/data-plane/scripts/bootstrap_dataplane.py

verified: postgrest anon denied on curated reads
postgrest JWT read 200 with RLS evaluation
tenant provisioned via management API (wrapped tenant object, control-DB extension record, never agentstore)
websocket join on private topic with role+exp JWT
REST broadcast 202 with private:true, subscriber received data-revision-changed
no CDC/publication/trigger created on agentstore or graph DB
known_limitations: verify script regenerates the tenant jwt_secret per run (dev only); production must pin REALTIME_TENANT_JWT_SECRET in secret storage
control-DB password mismatch after secret rotation requires volume recreate or ALTER ROLE (documented runbook step)
PostgREST connects with sslmode=prefer; agentstore offers plain here, require TLS before shared use
